newsitem.title: USA: Cross-Continent buys two auto dealerships.
newsitem.headline: Cross-Continent buys two auto dealerships.

text.p: Cross-Continent Auto Retailers Inc said on Friday it reached a definitive agreement to acquire Toyota West Sales and Service Inc in Las Vegas and Douglas Toyota Inc in Colorado for cash and stock totaling about $40 million.
The transactions were expected to be completed late in the first quarter, the company said.
Cross-Continent said R. Douglas Spedding, president of Toyota West and Douglas Toyota, would continue to manage the dealerships and be involved with future acquisitions.
The acquisition was subject to manufacturer approval, final board approval and other customary conditions, it said.
Cross-Continent completed an initial public offering in September.
